name: estimativas
description: Estimativas de desenvolvimento e de testes, feitas em equipe

scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only database --config firebase.test.json --project demo-estimativas "node --test test/rules.test.js"
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:rules && npm run test:e2e
scripts.deploy:rules: npm run build:rules && firebase deploy --only database
scripts.test:e2e: firebase emulators:exec --only database,auth --config firebase.test.json --project demo-estimativas "node --test test/e2e.test.mjs"
